text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis that \"the negative aspects outweigh the positive ones\"","quality":"clear position","description":"The essay states a definite argumentative stance early and keeps that position visible throughout."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs each centered on a different drawback","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops its argument in a more structured way by separating major points into distinct paragraphs."},{"evidence":"uses quoted evidence from the article about needing to take over and cameras watching the driver","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay supports claims with specific details from the source rather than relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"explains why the takeover requirement makes driving \"more of a hassle than a luxury\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more fully connects evidence to its claim by explaining how the cited facts weaken the case for driverless cars."},{"evidence":"mentions complexity, attention, and cost as consequences of the technology","quality":"analysis","description":"The essay shows more interpretive depth by discussing the practical implications of the article's details instead of only listing them."},{"evidence":"concluding paragraph restates the claim and broadens it to investment priorities","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a more developed closing that reinforces the argument and leaves the reader with a final judgment."}]}
